errors.evidence: The line in the chart does not have any visible markers at the data points.
The value for 2010 is approximately 0.1 million, not 0.8 million. The value 0.8 million corresponds to the year 2016.
The value for 2012 is approximately 0.3 million, not 1.6 million.
The value for 2014 is approximately 0.5 million, not 2.2 million. The value 2.2 million corresponds to the year 2018.
The value for 2016 is approximately 0.8 million, not 3.0 million. The value is closer to 3.1 million for the year 2020.
The section of the line leading up to 2020 (specifically from 2016 to 2020) is not 'relatively flat'. It shows a clear and accelerating increase from approximately 0.8 million to 3.1 million.
The value for 2020 is approximately 3.1 million, not 4.7 million.
The value for 2021 is approximately 6.8 million, not 7.4 million.
